test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to the Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP) which state ranked as the best performer in start-up ranking 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gujarat** was ranked as the best performer in start-up ranking 2019 by the Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP).
 
• The ranking evaluates states based on their support for startup ecosystems and the implementation of various policies and initiatives to foster startup growth.
 
• Gujarat's top ranking reflects its strong infrastructure, favorable policies, and proactive measures in promoting startups and innovation.
 
• The state has implemented several schemes and initiatives to support budding entrepreneurs, including financial incentives, incubation centers, and mentorship programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP)** is responsible for formulating and implementing promotional and developmental measures for the growth of the industrial sector in India.
 
• In addition to startup rankings, DIPP also works on policies related to intellectual property rights, foreign direct investment, and industrial development.
 
• Gujarat has consistently performed well in various industrial and economic rankings, showcasing its robust economic environment and governance.
 
• The state government continues to focus on creating a conducive ecosystem for startups by simplifying regulatory processes, providing financial support, and encouraging innovation.
